title: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
description: Rackspace warned customers that hackers breached its Rackspace Spot cloud platform using compromised credentials, allowing them to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets in customer clusters. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
description: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: BADBOX botnet returns with record-breaking 40 billion daily ad requests
description: The BADBOX malware found in a broad range of generic Android TV boxes has returned to large-scale ad-fraud operations following last year's disruptions. [...]
author: Bill Toulas

title: FBI reportedly hacked again, this time targeting nationwide police database
description: FBI systems have reportedly been breached for the second time in two months, this time targeting the agency's National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which is used to share information between local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams
